title: Edge compatibility of the concrete module/Ext resolution equivalence
statement: For any scheme morphism f:X -> Y, module F on X and nonnegative degree p, the explicit moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv of [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality] intertwines the module direct-image edge map [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] on f_*F with the abelian Ext map given by exact inverse image, constIso(f).symm and coeff(f,identity) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Thus for each x in module cohomology of f_*F, E_X,F(edge_f,F(x)) = H.map(coeff(f,identity),p)(H.mapFunctor(invImage(f),constIso(f).symm,underlying(f_*F),p)(E_Y,f_*F(x))). The E in this statement is the displayed resolution construction, not an arbitrary family of natural equivalences.
